How I approach technical work

I take time to understand what is actually happening before proposing software, so the tools I build fit the environment, earn trust, and stay maintainable after launch.

Process first

Map the current workflow, clarify the pain points, and build around the reality of the job instead of forcing people into generic tools.

Reliable implementation

Requirements, database structure, testing, rollout support, user training, troubleshooting, and iteration stay connected from start to finish.

Selected work

Representative projects across scheduling automation, lending-library systems, FileMaker workflows, and database-backed operations.
